notes.title: Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
This update includes the following fixes and improvements:


 Camera Shooting Bug: Fixed a bug where the camera would show an empty area when zooming.
 Camera Zoom Addition: Added a camera zoom mode.
 BGM Addition: Added background music to the title screen and during gameplay.
 Character Control Explanation Addition: Added an explanation about character jumping.

notes.title: Game Update - Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
This update includes the following fixes and improvements:

* Gold Orb Count Bug: Addressed an issue where the gold orb count was not displaying correctly.
* Checkpoint Explanation: Added a checkpoint explanation to the How to Play section.
* Rendering Performance: Optimized several elements that were causing high rendering load, resulting in improved performance, especially on lower-end hardware.
